description: Effortlessly manage, secure, and sync .env files directly inside VS Code with enterprise-grade encryption.
config.title: DotEnvy
config.backupPath: Path to store encrypted backups of .env files. Leave empty to use workspace folder.
config.encryptBackups: Enable AES-256 encryption for backup files.
config.history.retentionDays: Number of days to retain environment history.
config.history.maxEntries: Maximum number of history entries to keep.
config.history.autoCleanup: Automatically clean up old history entries.
config.cloudSync.encryptCloudSync: Encrypt secrets before syncing to cloud (End-to-End Encryption).
config.cloudSync.provider: Cloud provider to sync secrets with.
config.secrets.enableCloudAnalysis: Legacy setting; ignored. Classification is local. Use community learning to share numeric corrections.
command.toggleCloudAnalysis: DotEnvy: Toggle AI Cloud Secret Analysis
command.addUser: DotEnvy: Add User to Secure Project
views.container.title: DotEnvy
views.environments.name: Environment Switcher
views.commands.name: Secure Commands
config.secrets.cloudAnalysisDeprecated: Legacy setting; ignored. Classification is local. Use community learning to share numeric corrections.
config.secrets.enableCommunityLearning: Help improve DotAegis? New secret confirmations and false-positive corrections will send 35 numeric properties and your chosen label, authenticated with a device ID. Keys, code, file paths, variable names and fingerprints are never sent. The server retains these properties for review and shared model training; they are not guaranteed anonymous. Previous local corrections are not uploaded.
config.secrets.enableModelUpdates: Download shared inference weights from DotAegis at startup and hourly. Only a release request/revision is sent, never scanner inputs. Disable along with community learning for an offline scanner.
